name: new-react-component
title: Create React Component
description: Create a React component with types, styles, a hook, a demo, and settings. The tool accepts optional grid and class values.

settings.name: name
settings.title: Component Name
settings.description: Component name in any text style; generated folders and files use PascalCase.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Optional display title for the generated React component; defaults to its name.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Description
settings.description: Optional description for the generated React component.

settings.name: path
settings.title: Location
settings.description: Folder that will contain the component folder.

settings.name: save_as_text
settings.title: Save As Text
settings.description: Save the generated component as .txt for testing.

settings.name: grid
settings.title: Grid
settings.description: Optional canonical grid layout from the shared grid catalog. Use none or an empty value to skip.

settings.name: class_name
settings.title: Container Class
settings.description: Optional class string appended to the base class; no class resolver is available.
